description: Get a link for the user to read the haggl ID consent text and confirm it on haggl.ai, when they are not in this conversation to agree to it. Send them confirm_url (valid 30 minutes). After they confirm, call haggl_create_haggl_id with the returned confirmation; until then it answers confirmation_pending.
name: haggl_request_haggl_id_confirmation

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

confirm_url.description: Send this link to the user.

confirmation.description: Pass to haggl_create_haggl_id once the user confirmed.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.
